name: Matadeón de los Oteros (Spain)
description: Square blue flag charged at the centre with a yellow cross with the letters Alpha and Omega, surrounded by twelve white inverted triangles.
history: Municipal flag of Matadeón de los Oteros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross with flared arms between the letters Alpha and Omega
twelve inverted triangles around the edge
